name: Victorian medical cooling concession
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: 17.5% off summer electricity costs for Victorian Health Care Card holders with a medical condition affecting temperature regulation.
key: 17.5% of electricity usage and service costs between 1 November and 30 April.
who: Electricity account holder with a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or Veterans' Affairs Gold Card
You or a household member has a medical condition that affects the body's ability to self-regulate temperature
how: For an application form, phone your electricity retailer or the Concessions information line on 1800 658 521 (toll free).
Have your doctor complete and sign the form.
